key_insight: AlterNet combines shallow mixture-of-experts modules with learned halting to adapt inference depth and reduce compute after training without retraining.
engineering_relevance: Adaptive inference could help fit engineering AI workloads to latency and compute budgets, although the abstract reports no solid-mechanics-specific validation.
method: Iterative computation with sequence-level, depth-based expert routing.
Learned halting within experts and depth encoding to track progress.
Regularization to encourage efficient use of allocated compute.
evidence_signal: The abstract mentions initial benchmarks but provides no datasets, quantitative results, or accuracy–compute trade-offs.
watch_item: Accuracy under reduced compute and practical latency gains remain unclear from the abstract.
paper_title: AlterNet: Adaptive-Depth Mixture-of-Experts with Learned Halting for Elastic Inference
